RandomPreset.description: RandomPreset is a reusable item list selected by name from cargo or attachment rules in cfgspawnabletypes.xml.

chance.description: Chance is the probability, from 0 to 1, that this preset is selected when it is one of the candidates.

item.description: Items are the candidates provided by this preset.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by a spawn rule's `preset` attribute.

RandomPresetsFile.description: RandomPresetsFile defines reusable cargo and attachment candidate lists for `cfgspawnabletypes.xml`.

attachments.description: Attachments contains presets referenced by attachment rules.

cargo.description: Cargo contains presets referenced by cargo rules.

randompresets.description: XMLName identifies the required `<randompresets>` document root.

SpawnableAttachment.description: SpawnableAttachment defines one attachment-generation rule for an item.

chance.description: Chance is the probability, from 0 to 1, that this attachment rule is selected.

item.description: Items are attachment candidates listed directly instead of in a named preset.

preset.description:
Preset names an attachment preset from cfgrandompresets.xml.
When set, the preset provides the candidate items for this attachment rule.

SpawnableCargo.description: SpawnableCargo defines one cargo-generation rule for an item.

chance.description: Chance is the probability, from 0 to 1, that this cargo rule is selected.

item.description: Items are item candidates listed directly instead of in a named preset.

preset.description:
Preset names a cargo preset from cfgrandompresets.xml.
When set, the preset provides the candidate items for this cargo rule.

SpawnableItem.description: SpawnableItem is one item candidate in cargo, attachment, or random-preset rules.

attachments.description: Attachments defines items that may be attached to this item.

cargo.description: Cargo defines items that may be generated inside this item.

chance.description:
Chance is a probability from 0 to 1, or a percentage weight
when the explicit chance values in its parent group use the 0 to 100 scale.

damage.description: Damage sets the health range for this item when it is spawned.

name.description: Name is the game class name of the candidate item.

SpawnableMinMax.description: SpawnableMinMax stores a lower and upper bound used to randomize a numeric property when an item is created.

max.description: Max is the inclusive upper bound for the generated property.

min.description: Min is the inclusive lower bound for the generated property.
